dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Be careful not to disturb anyone while you're up there.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: I know, I know. I was already warned by a young girl out gathering herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Huh. You look surprised. Did you think I didn't know how this place is home to the adepti of Liyue? Or are you just shocked that I'm making friends with the locals?

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: To be fair, I'm a little surprised by that last one myself.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: That kid was so small she could hardly form a proper sentence, but she climbed all the way up here. Are all people from Liyue born naturally good at extreme sports?
